name: Voxel Prior Loss
definition: A regularization loss term that constrains 3D Gaussians to align with a precomputed voxel grid occupancy, enforcing empty voxel suppression and occupied voxel geometric fitting.
summary: Voxel Prior Loss is a regularization term for 3D Gaussian Splatting that aligns primitives with a voxel grid to suppress floating artifacts and enforce geometric priors.
